title: Visa versus admission to the United States
facts: A U.S. visa generally allows a foreign traveler to travel to a U.S. port of entry and request admission; it does not guarantee entry.
CBP makes the admission decision at the port of entry and determines the authorized status and period of stay when applicable.
The visa expiration date is not necessarily the same as the date through which a traveler is authorized to remain in the United States.
Travelers should use their admission record, including Form I-94 when applicable, to understand the authorized period of stay.
